name: Slow DCA: $B0ASEX
description: Buys $B0ASEX in small, even amounts (dollar-cost averaging) from the cheapest market listings. At most $1 a buy, $3 a day, $60 in total, and it stops once it holds 50,000 tokens. It can lose money: token prices can fall and listings can be thin.
goals: Dollar-cost average into $B0ASEX. Buy about $1 of the cheapest listing up to three times a day, spread out. Never buy more than $1 at once and never try to catch up on missed days.

spec.needs: Agent account with at least $10 of BSV
